About Me

Awais — CNC Designer

Mera naam Awais hai aur ma ek professional CNC Designer hon. Ma 2D aur 3D wood carving designs banata hon, jin mein jali, beds, sofas, panel doors aur 3D relief models shamil hain. Meri har design Aspire aur ArtCAM par tayar hoti hai aur CNC machine par asani se chalti hai.

Ma customer ke order ke mutabiq custom design bhi banata hon aur online course ke zariye Aspire 9.5, 10.5 aur ArtCAM 2018 bhi sikhata hon. Mera maqsad hai ke apko saaf, professional aur machine-ready design milay.
